appearance.hideGameCoverHint: When a custom background is enabled, hide the last-played game's cover on the home page
appearance.hideGameHeroCover: Hide Home Page Large Game Cover
appearance.hideGameHeroCoverHint: When a custom background is enabled, hide the large cover image of the most recently played game shown at the bottom-left of the home page
appearance.homeGameCarouselHint: When enabled, the home page automatically switches between recently played games. Opening the game rail pauses the carousel.
appearance.homeGameCarouselIntervalHint: Minimum {{seconds}} seconds. After closing the game rail, the carousel resumes with this interval.
appearance.gameCardLayoutHint: The wide horizontal layout works better for landscape covers. Portrait keeps the existing card ratio.

appearance.opacityHint: Adjust the overlay opacity of the content area. Lower values make the background more visible.

game.timingModeHint: Process tracking: timing starts and ends automatically with the game process. Fine-tune with the options below.
game.timingModeManualHint: Manual timing: the clock starts as soon as you press "Launch", with no process tracking at all. When you are done, return to YukiHub and press the stop button on the timing island. This is how the mobile app times play and it is the most accurate.
game.recordActiveOnlyHint: When enabled, play time is only recorded when the game window is in the foreground focus. This provides a more accurate measure of actual play time, excluding idle and background time.
game.processDetectionTimeoutHint: After launching a game, YukiHub keeps looking for the actual game process for this duration. Longer waits help games that compile shaders or otherwise take longer to start through Steam.
game.processDetectionTimeoutWarning: Avoid changing this wait time unless necessary. For games whose play time cannot be monitored, a longer wait delays detection failure and may leave YukiHub searching for the game process for an extended period.
game.lePathHint: Found automatically at startup if Locale Emulator is installed — no need to type a path. You can also drop the tool folder into the app's compat-tools directory. Once set, region-switching launch becomes available in the game editor.
game.defaultUseLe: Enable Locale Emulator for new games
game.magpiePathHint: Found automatically at startup if Magpie is installed — no need to type a path. You can also drop the tool folder into the app's compat-tools directory. Once set, super-resolution scaling becomes available in the game editor.

toast.detectNotFound: Not found. Put the tool in {{dir}}, or pick the file manually.

game.muteInBackgroundHint: Mutes games launched through YukiHub when they lose foreground focus and restores sound when you return to them.
game.protontricksPathHint: Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH and common locations. Steam Proton shortcuts prefer this tool.
game.winePrefixHint: Used as the default Wine prefix when a game has no per-game value.
game.wineRunnerPathHint: Choose the actual Wine executable. Configure CrossOver separately below.
game.winetricksPathHint: Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH and common locations. Used for Wine registry and Wine configuration shortcuts.
